system.description:
Also at 6th Level, you can use your Rending Thoughts feature as a Bonus action. You cannot use it as an Action if used in this way. If used as an Action on your turn, you cannot use it as a Bonus Action on the same turn.

| Corrupt Thoughts – Mentally Compromised / This special condition is treated as a Mental Condition. / A Mentally Compromised creature finds it difficult to shut out psychic intrusion. They treat a failure as a Critical failure vs Genjutsu with the Tactile keyword. The first time this effect occurs, this condition ends. / Additionally, once per turn, when a Mentally Compromised creature makes a Concentration check to maintain concentration on a jutsu, they must first spend 4 Chakra to make the check, if they choose not to, they immediately lose concentration as if they failed the check. This effect increases in strength at 6th level, becoming 6 Chakra. This boost occurs again at 10th (8), 14th (10) and 18th (12) levels. / Enhanced Effect (Lvl 10). A Mentally Compromised creature radiates a 15ft radius aura of madness. The first time each turn a creature allied to it within its madness aura casts a Jutsu, they must roll a DC 11 Flat Check. On a failure, the Genjutsu Specialist can cause the failing creatures Jutsu to be Interrupted as it falls into a short psychotic break. Once a creature is interrupted in this way, this condition ends. |

When you use your Rending Thoughts feature you can spend 1 Actualization Die to also enhance its effects on a Failure and Critical Failure, draining their physical skills and experience and potentially adding them to your own.

Failure. They also suffer a -1 penalty to their Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saving throw until the end of your next turn. (This becomes -2 at 14th level, and -3 at 18th level)

Critical Failure. Same as failure, but the caster also gains a +1 bonus to their Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saving throw until the end of your next turn. (This becomes +2 at 14th level, and +3 at 18th level)
